description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Road arcs, address ranges and street identifiers provide transport-network geometry; the source explicitly identifies routing and geocoding. The native layer exposes polyline geometry and named attributes, including ROADS_ID, LFROM, LTO, RFROM, RTO, PREDIR. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for network flow studies. Currentness varies by contributing jurisdiction; duplicate boundary arcs can exist where street names differ. The supporting street-alias archive was not fetched. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
